headline: Colombia's Opposition Proposes Alternative Tax Reform
summary: An alternative tax reform proposed by former President Álvaro Uribe's Centro Democrático party suggests eliminating the wealth tax and the 4x1,000 financial transaction tax. The proposal also seeks to lower the corporate income tax rate from 35% to 30%.
why: Tax policy proposals from major political figures influence fiscal outlooks, corporate earnings expectations, and investor sentiment in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Proposed changes to corporate and financial taxes affect corporate profitability and government revenues.
